name: MultiPlaneGAN
definition: A GAN-based 3D generation framework that replaces the tri-plane representation of EG3D with a MultiPlane 3D representation consisting of 32 planes posed on a sphere, using a lightweight feature decoder and neural volume renderer.
summary: MultiPlaneGAN is a GAN-based 3D generation framework that synthesizes objects using 32 feature planes posed on a sphere, differing from EG3D by using a spherical distribution rather than axis-aligned orthogonal planes.
